verdict.rationale: Local emulation of the production runtime is a fair question for a cloud application platform, but the evidence pack documents no local simulator or emulator for Render. The nearest items are adjacent rather than local: Docker support, ephemeral preview environments, short-lived cloud instances for one-off commands, and CLI validation of render.yaml. None of these lets a developer run and test the app locally against a production-matching simulator.

support.subject: As a developer, I can develop and test my app locally using a simulator that matches the production runtime
